learning_outcomes.objective: Understand the physical nature of matter.
Identify the three states of matter and their properties.
Explain how temperature and pressure change the state of matter.
Understand the process of evaporation and its cooling effect.

ai_context.learning_goal: Master the concept that everything in the universe is made of tiny moving particles, and understand how energy (heat) changes their arrangement.
common_misconceptions: Thinking that air is not matter because you can't see it.
Believing that particles expand when heated (the space between them expands, not the particles themselves).
Confusing boiling (bulk phenomenon) with evaporation (surface phenomenon).
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student to wave their hand in the air. Can they feel the wind? That wind is made of particles hitting their hand! Also, use the perfume example to explain particle movement (diffusion).
